producer_report.summary: Added `truncate_at_word(text, max)` and `SUBJECT_MAX` (72) in athena-core's lib.rs. The helper returns fitting text unchanged, cuts over-limit text at the last whitespace within the limit, and hard-cuts a single over-long word. It works on char boundaries, so multibyte text can't panic. It replaces the three `.chars().take(72)` cuts: the intervention commit subject (via new `intervention_subject` in manage.rs), the reading title (via new `reading_title` in reading.rs) and the title fallback in store.rs. Added helper unit tests, one subject test and one title test, plus a CHANGELOG entry. Root cause was that each site cut by character count with no regard for words; one shared helper now covers all three. `cargo fmt`, clippy with warnings denied, and the full `cargo test --locked` pass.

checks_run.note: ran `cargo fmt --all` to apply formatting; no differences left
every suite reported 0 failed; ran in quiet mode for the final result

criteria_check.criterion: Unit tests for the new helper pass under `cargo test`: over-limit text is cut at the last whitespace within 72 chars so no word is split; text at or under the limit is unchanged; a single over-long word is hard-cut at 72 chars; multibyte text does not panic.
criteria_check.evidence: The four tests in lib.rs `truncate_tests` cover these cases and pass under `cargo test --locked`.

criteria_check.criterion: A `cargo test` test builds a long intervention subject (manage.rs) and a long reading title (reading.rs) from multi-word text and shows neither ends mid-word and both are at most 72 chars.
criteria_check.evidence: `manage::subject_tests::a_long_intervention_subject_is_cut_at_a_word_boundary` and `reading::tests::a_long_reading_title_is_cut_at_a_word_boundary` assert length <= 72 and that the next char is a space. Both pass.

criteria_check.criterion: The three `.chars().take(72)` sites (manage.rs subject, reading.rs title, store.rs title fallback) call the shared helper instead.
criteria_check.evidence: A grep for `take(72)` found three sites before the change. All three now call `crate::truncate_at_word`.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo clippy`, `cargo fmt --check` and the full `cargo test` all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: All three were run and passed. The first clippy run flagged items after a test module in manage.rs; I moved the tests to the end of the file and clippy then passed.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md notes that generated commit subjects and titles are cut at word boundaries.
criteria_check.evidence: A new first bullet under Unreleased > Changed says this.

mistakes: The first draft put the manage.rs test module before later functions, which clippy rejected. Fixed by moving it to the end of the file.
learnings: Clippy denies items after a test module (items_after_test_module), so tests must go at the end of the file.
manage.rs had no test module before this change.
